Indian Embassy Rescues Tamil Nadu Woman from Alleged Torture in Kuwait

An Indian woman from Tamil Nadu's Kallakurichi district has been rescued in Kuwait after posting a video alleging torture and non-payment of wages for three months. The Indian Embassy in Kuwait intervened to assist the woman. She reportedly stated, 'They are torturing me.'
